name: the-appearance-pane-picks-the-app-icon
description: The Appearance pane shows the 21 icon tiles, a click on crimson-ink persists the choice, and the Dock icon follows. The startup apply must also log, because the bundle icon is crimson-paper and the setting defaults to it.

actions.note: gate: the startup tab committed, so the app is up
let the window build and its route load
select the pane by its id, not by a coordinate the rail layout can move

actions.expression: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('.settings-row-appicon'); if (!row) return 'no-row'; row.scrollIntoView(); const imgs = [...row.querySelectorAll('img')]; return imgs.length + '/' + imgs.filter(i => i.naturalWidth > 0).length; })()
actions.note: 21 tiles, and every one loaded its PNG through the request filter

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.settings-app-icon[data-variant="crimson-ink"]'); if (!b) return 'no-tile'; b.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

actions.note: the save round trip and the Dock apply

assertions.label: the-startup-apply-ran
assertions.pattern: Atrium: (app icon variant '[a-z0-9-]+' applied|no app icon for variant '[a-z0-9-]+')
assertions.note: The VM's settings.json can hold a retired slug. Then the PNG is missing and the bundle icon stays, which is the documented fallback. Either line proves the startup path ran.
